forces: The collector accepts evidence and keeps none of it: ingress states that acceptance is admission only and makes no durability claim, so every property a pilot would need to observe belongs to a component that does not exist yet.

The only state the collector holds is an instance-local deduplication ledger bounded at 32 records with a five-minute expiry, whose own capacity outcome would be indistinguishable from a retention expiry if it were mistaken for a durability record.

Acknowledging admission ahead of a write would convert a collector crash into evidence loss the producer has already been told did not happen, and the security-significant delivery row entitles that producer to stop retrying once accepted.

Retention and integrity are not independent: field-level expiry inside a retained record invalidates any whole-record integrity computation, so a retention policy chosen without that constraint forecloses a future scheme before anyone decides whether to want it.

Storage, backend selection, deployment, and the pilot each sit behind an authorization this delegated decision cannot supply, so the decision must bound what the collector may claim without lifting any boundary.

candidate_approaches.summary: Ratify collector storage semantics as a decision-only capability: two acknowledgment kinds with persisted following a confirmed write; a three-operation port, idempotent on event identity, whose backend selection is separately governed; record-derived retention; whole-record deletion preserving a retention-stable projection; distinct outcomes for outright and indeterminate write failure; cross-tenant reads inexpressible; encryption at rest with separated key custody; three named owner roles; migration and recovery boundaries; provenance and assurance limits. Implements no storage.

approach-decide-alongside-a-backend-sele.reason: The issue places choosing infrastructure by implementation convenience explicitly out of scope, and with a three-operation port almost any backend conforms, so availability would become the differentiator and availability is not a security property; selection also needs an owner authorization a delegated decision cannot supply.

forces: The only state the collector holds is an instance-local deduplication ledger bounded at 32 records with a five-minute expiry, whose own capacity outcome would be indistinguishable from a retention expiry if it were mistaken for a durability record.
approach-extend-the-deduplication-ledger.reason: The ledger is instance-local, capped at 32 live records, expires after five minutes, and declares in its own header that records are never durable; building retention semantics on it would make a capacity eviction and a retention expiry the same observable event, which is the one confusion an audit store may not have.

approach-defer-to-adapter-implementation.reason: An adapter written before the model is stated encodes whichever default the backend made convenient, and the convenient defaults here are precisely acknowledge-early and field-level expiry — the two that lose evidence and foreclose integrity respectively; the issue also requires the decision to precede implementation.

evidence_ids: the capability admits exactly two acknowledgment kinds and requires persisted to follow a confirmed write, with a scenario asserting no persisted acknowledgment is issued while a write is outstanding

the port is three operations over closed total result unions and is idempotent on event identity within a tenant scope, which is what makes treating an indeterminate write as not persisted safe from duplication

retention derives from the record's own data.retention_class rather than from deployment configuration, deletion is whole-record so a retention-stable projection remains available, and a deployment may only decline to store rather than silently shorten
outright write failure and indeterminate write each carry a distinct diagnostic, neither is acknowledged as persisted, and an unsupported stored version is distinguishable from an absent record

the change touches no packages or contracts path, the production scope gate still rejects storage as a filename, import, and export token, and the capability states that it authorizes no implementation, backend selection, deployment, or pilot
